source: Alvarez, Cordeau, Jans paper PDF, Section 4.2 and Appendix B
notes: The paper states that SAA sample problems use a 30 minute time limit, yielding a maximum of 10 hours for M=20 samples; the full-Omega evaluation time is additional and usually under 15 minutes.
The reproduction scripts use one asynchronous job per method-instance pair and do not run the full experiment synchronously inside the coding agent session.
